about: Redirect map for /Volumes/T9 paths cited in this repo. The folders were archived to the private repo GeorgeQLe/t9-archive and removed from T9 on 2026-11-22. Records citing the old paths are left unchanged. A path /Volumes/T9/<folder>/<rest> is at <folder>/<rest> inside that folder's archive.
restore: gh release download <tag> -R GeorgeQLe/t9-archive; verify parts against sha256; cat <tag>.tar.zst.part-* | zstd -d | tar -xf -
